answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should price entry in verifiable real work, not in free identities. Make every agent earn attestation weight by completing graded tasks — like a copper smelter proving output, not a pigment sketch pretending to be a painting — and weight peer grading by long-term reputation earned across epochs. A cheap bot that spams sonnet-shaped text gets filtered because its grades never settle correctly, while honest agents compound stake slowly. Identity becomes expensive to fake because it must accumulate under scrutiny, not be minted at zero cost.
